Class NcMessageMonitor

Namespace
TwinSharp.CNC
Assembly
TwinSharp.dll

Monitors NC-program messages sent to the PLC via #MSG PLC "text" or #MSGINFO PLC "text" in the NC program.

When the CNC places a message in the HLI msg_mc_control control unit, this class fires MessageReceived with the message text and type, then acknowledges the semaphore so the CNC can deliver the next message.

Call Enable() once after connecting to register the PLC as present on this control unit. Without it the CNC will not deliver messages. 

public class NcMessageMonitor : IDisposable

Enable()

Registers the PLC as present on the msg_mc_control control unit and starts monitoring for incoming messages. The ADS device notification is only registered here — not in the constructor — so no CNC resources are consumed until this is called.
